## Reports

This appendix documents the specifications of all the reports for the [Application]. These reports are on-demand and generated on a weekly and monthly basis. There is no automated schedule. These reports can be accessed by any team member regardless of the roles within the Application. Gainwell Technologies (hereinafter Gainwell) sends only the monthly report to the Department of Health Care Services (DHCS). The different types of reports generated are as follows:
